## Abstract

This document demonstrates how to convert Jupyter notebooks from the monorepo into publication-ready documents using Quarto.

## Introduction

Mathematical notation works seamlessly: $E[X] = \sum_{i} p_i x_i$

## Methods

Execute code from your monorepo packages:

```{python}
# Import from monorepo packages
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy_extensions import normal_mixture

# Generate example data
weights = [0.3, 0.7]
means = [0, 2]
stds = [1, 0.5]
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

samples, components = normal_mixture.sample(
    1000, weights, means, stds, random_state=rng
)

# Create figure
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.hist(samples, bins=50, alpha=0.7, density=True,
         color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
plt.title('Normal Mixture Sample Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Value')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
